study: Employer Training Investment Capacity: A Longitudinal UK Study
finding: UK employer training spend per employee fell from £2,410 in 2011 to £1,700 in 2024 in 2024 prices (−29.5%). At the same time, the survey-derived trained-employee share rose from about 60.2% in 2022 to 62.8% in 2024. In 2024, sector spending ranged from £920 per employee in Public Administration to £2,630 in Construction, showing that reach and investment intensity can move differently.
source: UK Employer Skills Survey 2024 — Investment in Training
